newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT plans scheme to speed up workforce cut -- paper.
newsitem.headline: NTT plans scheme to speed up workforce cut -- paper.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) will offer a better early retirement programme to employees in an effort to speed up a reduction in its workforce, a Japanese business daily said on Wednesday.
The new programme is expected to help NTT improve its competitiveness in time for its reorganisation in the year from April 1, 1999, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Under the new programme, NTT will increase cash severance payments from September for middle-aged workers who take early retirement, Nihon Keizai said.
By doing so, NTT expects to cut about 10,000 workers, it said.
In 1995, NTT said it would cut its workforce to 150,000 by 2000 from 182,500, the paper said.
The firm was not immediately available for comment on the report.
